overall_assessment: Core sections (course_content, learning_outcomes, teaching_methods, reading_list, assessment body) are extracted cleanly and completely on NMBU, including full Kunnskap/Ferdigheter/Generell kompetanse groups. Two systematic defects: the 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' block is never extracted (no coursework_requirements rows), and prerequisites swallows the trailing metadata block (CSS junk, admission code, responsible person name) in most courses. The two pre-pass flags are false alarms.

findings.evidence: Emnet forutsetter solid kompetanse i fag 1 og 2. Realfag Studieår: .css-b62m3t-container{position:relative;box-sizing:border-box;}
findings.description: The prerequisites section runs past 'Forutsatte forkunnskaper' into the page metadata block: Opptakskrav/admission code, 'Studieår:', React-select CSS rules, Studiepoeng, faculty, teaching place, language, frequency, workload and period text, and the course coordinator's full name ('Emneansvarlig' followed by a person name). Real prerequisite text is 50-300 chars but the section is ~2000-2300 chars. Seen in 6 of 10 packet courses (PPRA301, FYS100, M60-LUN, MATH100, PPXP100 and the like). Personal names are left in the section text.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Lines after the last recognised heading ('Forutsatte forkunnskaper' / 'Opptakskrav') such as 'Studieår:', CSS, 'Studiepoeng', 'Emneansvarlig' are not headings in R/section_heading_map.R, so they are appended to prerequisites through to the end of the document. The CSS comes from inline <style> text in the selected page area that is not removed in fulltext extraction.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/extract_sections.R (.clean_sections or an nmbu pre-step) cut the plan at the first line matching '^Studieår:' and delete lines matching '^\.css-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\{' plus stray 'til 20\d\d' lines. Better: strip <style> nodes in the nmbu fulltext extraction (pre_fn in R/institution_config.R) so the CSS never reaches extracted_text. Treat 'Opptakskrav' as a known heading mapped to an ignored bucket.

findings.description: For PPXP100 the plan has no 'Forutsatte forkunnskaper' section at all; the prerequisites row consists only of the 'Opptakskrav: Realfag' admission line followed by CSS and metadata. A prerequisites row is emitted although there is no prerequisite content. For other courses (MATH100, FYS100, M60-LUN) the admission requirement is appended to the real prerequisites.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Opptakskrav' is mapped to prerequisites in R/section_heading_map.R (or its text is appended to the preceding prerequisites section), so admission text and everything after it becomes prerequisites.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not map 'Opptakskrav' to prerequisites, and suppress the prerequisites row when nothing remains after removing metadata/CSS.

findings.evidence: Obligatorisk aktivitet 15 dager praksisopplæring (gruppe) Plan for praksis med egne mål (individuell)
findings.description: Every plan in the packet has an 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' heading with concrete approve/fail gates (practice days, plans, reports, 80% attendance, lab tasks, supervisor contract), yet no course has a coursework_requirements row. The content is dropped entirely; it is not misfiled into assessment either.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: R/section_heading_map.R likely has no pattern for 'Obligatorisk aktivitet' (singular), so the heading maps to nothing and its text is discarded.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a pattern '^obligatoriske? aktivitet(er)?$' mapped to coursework_requirements in R/section_heading_map.R, and verify it stops at the next heading ('Undervisningstider', 'Merknader', 'Fortrinnsrett').

findings.evidence: Muntlig eksamen Karakterregel: Bokstavkarakterer Hjelpemiddelkode: A1 Ingen kalkulator, ingen andre hjelpemidler
findings.description: Assessment ends with a flattened auto-generated exam-logistics line (Karakterregel / Hjelpemiddelkode, i.e. grading scale and aids code) preceded by blank-line gaps. This is exam logistics residue, repeated in every course. The substantive assessment text is correct and complete, and KI/Sensorordning text is correctly excluded.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The exam table rendered directly after the assessment paragraph is flattened into one line and stays inside the 'Vurderingsordning, hjelpemiddel og eksamen' section.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (or an nmbu-specific post_fn) remove lines matching 'Karakterregel:.*' from assessment and collapse runs of blank lines.
